meta.styleLock: Look: strongly faceted low-poly 3D world with flat-shaded polygons and crisp edges; clean geometric Persian architecture with turquoise and gold tilework, gold domes, sand clay walls, terracotta paving, saffron and indigo textiles; saturated sunset palette of magenta, violet and orange; soft real light and shadows, no outlines.
meta.locationDesc: a walled low-poly Persian city in the desert: a palace with a turquoise-and-gold iwan and a gold dome behind a long garden with a reflecting pool; a great arcaded square; a covered bazaar leading to a turquoise-domed mosque with two minarets and a gold-domed shrine; flat-roofed clay houses with wind towers; dunes, three pyramids to the south-west and blue mountains to the north

objects.name: Principessa
objects.desc: Low-poly strikingly beautiful adult woman, 172 cm, slim hourglass figure, original face with high cheekbones, full lips, winged kohl eyes, olive skin, glossy black side braid on the left shoulder, gold diadem with one ruby, rose-pink veil, fitted burgundy tunic with gold embroidery, saffron sash, wide saffron trousers, gold slippers, two gold bangles per wrist.

objects.name: Lova
objects.desc: Low-poly Lova in Persian streetwear: short dark hair, thin moustache and chin beard, slim red-lens sunglasses with gold temples, pearl-bead necklace with one white broken-heart pendant, open deep indigo hoodie with gold arabesques and a gold Simurgh on the back, white tee, one watch per wrist, very baggy cream jeans with turquoise tile graphics, silver wallet chain, tan work boots.

objects.name: Djinn
objects.desc: Low-poly djinn, adult man, about 260 cm with tail, original face, copper skin with glowing turquoise lines, turquoise eyes, white beard in two braids, white-and-saffron turban with one emerald, one silver chain across the bare chest, no legs: violet faceted smoke tail. Empty hands.

objects.name: Tappeto volante
objects.desc: One single low-poly flying carpet, 2 x 1.4 m, 2 cm thick, deep indigo field, one terracotta-and-gold eight-pointed star medallion in the centre, gold geometric border, exactly four gold corner tassels, plain indigo underside.

objects.name: Lampada magica
objects.desc: One single low-poly brass oil lamp, 30 cm long, boat-shaped body on a round foot, long spout on the right, curled handle on the left, hinged dome lid with one turquoise stone on top, one band of engraved arabesques around the body.

beats.text: @char_lova_persian_v1 walks toward the gate, small puffs of sand at each step, the indigo hoodie lifting in the warm wind.
He keeps walking; the turquoise-tiled arch of the gate grows around him and the gold palace dome appears above the wall.
He slows inside the shadow of the gateway and lifts his chin toward the city.

shots.purpose: Opening of the music video: @char_lova_persian_v1 walks alone out of the desert toward the open south gate of the walled Persian city at sunset; the crane descends behind him until the gate frames him and the gold palace dome and the minarets rise beyond the walls
shots.locks: no vehicles; no modern objects, wires or signs; no other people

loc.time: sunset, low sun in the west
loc.desc: Low-poly walled Persian city seen from the desert at sunset: sand clay walls with crenellations, one tall open south gate with a turquoise-tiled arch, beyond it flat-roofed clay houses, minarets and the gold palace dome

beats.text: @char_lova_persian_v1 walks up the main street toward the camera, the city gate glowing gold behind him.
He looks up at the wind towers and small domes on the clay houses, turning his head slowly to the left.
He pushes his red-lens sunglasses up onto his head and a half smile appears.

shots.purpose: @char_lova_persian_v1 walks up the main street of the city at sunset, seen from a low frontal angle as the camera moves back in front of him; the glowing south gate and the clay houses with wind towers behind him
shots.locks: no vehicles; no modern objects, wires or signs; no other people

loc.time: sunset, low sun in the west
loc.desc: Low-poly main street of a Persian city at sunset: terracotta paving, two rows of sand clay houses with small domes and wind towers, the tall south gate glowing at the end of the street

beats.text: @char_lova_persian_v1 stops at the edge of the great square, the long pool and the turquoise arcades ahead; @char_persian_princess_v1 stands by the pool and turns to him.
@char_persian_princess_v1 lifts her hand and waves him to follow, a bright smile.
She turns and runs toward the arcades on frame-left, looking back once; @char_lova_persian_v1 takes his first step after her.

shots.purpose: In the great square at sunset, over @char_lova_persian_v1's right shoulder: @char_persian_princess_v1 stands by the long pool, waves him to follow and runs toward the arcades; @char_lova_persian_v1 stays dominant in the foreground

loc.time: sunset, low sun in the west
loc.desc: Low-poly great square of a Persian city at sunset: a long rectangular pool, two-storey arcades with turquoise-tiled arches on all sides, the covered bazaar entrance on the west side

beats.text: @char_persian_princess_v1 pulls @char_lova_persian_v1 by the hand along the covered bazaar at a brisk walk, shafts of sunset light crossing them one after another.
@char_lova_persian_v1 turns his head to the brass lamps and the hanging kilims as they pass, still walking.
@char_persian_princess_v1 looks back over her shoulder at him and laughs; the turquoise arch at the end of the alley comes closer behind the camera.

shots.purpose: @char_persian_princess_v1 leads @char_lova_persian_v1 by the hand through the covered bazaar at sunset, the camera moving backward in front of them; @char_lova_persian_v1 stays centred and sharp, the brass lamps, hanging kilims and sun shafts sliding past, the turquoise arch of the mosque at the far end
shots.locks: no vehicles; no modern objects, wires or signs; no other people

loc.desc: Low-poly narrow covered Persian bazaar alley at sunset: brass merchant stall left with hanging lamps, trays and teapots on a wooden counter; rug stall right with three hanging kilims and four spice baskets in cones; saffron and indigo canopies with sun shafts; clay walls; turquoise tiled arch and dome at the far end

beats.text: @char_persian_princess_v1 holds out @prop_magic_lamp_lp_v1 to @char_lova_persian_v1 with both hands; he looks at it, then at her.
@char_lova_persian_v1 takes the lamp; its weight drops his wrists slightly.
He lifts it to his chest and studies the engraved arabesques, the low sun flaring along the brass; @char_persian_princess_v1 steps back to watch.

shots.purpose: On the rooftop terrace at sunset @char_persian_princess_v1 gives @char_lova_persian_v1 the magic lamp; @char_lova_persian_v1 faces the camera with the turquoise mosque dome, its minarets and the low sun behind him, the lamp catching the light

loc.time: sunset, sun low behind the domes
loc.desc: Low-poly flat rooftop terrace above a Persian bazaar at sunset: sand clay parapet, two striped saffron-and-indigo awnings on wooden poles left, three brass lanterns, one wooden bench, two clay jars and one rolled purple kilim right; turquoise and gold domes, two minarets, low sun behind

beats.text: @char_lova_persian_v1 raises @prop_magic_lamp_lp_v1 above his head with both hands, the low sun behind him, and rubs its side once with his thumb.
Violet faceted smoke pours from the spout and swirls up behind his left shoulder.
@char_djinn_v1 rises out of the smoke behind him and grows to full height, turquoise lines glowing, arms folding across his chest; @char_lova_persian_v1 does not turn, a slow grin.
@char_persian_princess_v1 on frame-right steps back with her hands raised in awe.

shots.purpose: Low-angle hero shot on the rooftop at sunset: @char_lova_persian_v1 raises the magic lamp above his head and @char_djinn_v1 grows out of violet smoke behind his shoulder, towering over him; @char_lova_persian_v1 stays in the centre, calm and in control
shots.locks: no vehicles; no modern objects, wires or signs; no other people

loc.time: sunset, sun low behind the domes
loc.desc: Low-poly flat rooftop terrace above a Persian bazaar at sunset: sand clay parapet, two striped saffron-and-indigo awnings on wooden poles left, three brass lanterns, one wooden bench, two clay jars and one rolled purple kilim right; turquoise and gold domes, two minarets, low sun behind

beats.text: @char_djinn_v1 points at @prop_flying_carpet_lp_v1 hovering beyond the parapet; @char_lova_persian_v1 walks to it and steps on, the carpet dipping under his weight.
@char_lova_persian_v1 kneels at the front and holds out his hand; @char_persian_princess_v1 takes it, steps on behind him and sits.
The carpet rises and glides west toward the turquoise dome and the low sun, its tassels fluttering, @char_lova_persian_v1's hoodie blowing back.

shots.purpose: @char_djinn_v1 points at @prop_flying_carpet_lp_v1 hovering at the edge of the rooftop; @char_lova_persian_v1 steps on first, offers his hand to @char_persian_princess_v1, and the carpet lifts off and glides west toward the turquoise mosque dome and the low sun

beats.text: @prop_flying_carpet_lp_v1 flies north above the great square, @char_lova_persian_v1 kneeling at the front, hoodie snapping in the wind, @char_persian_princess_v1 seated behind him, the turquoise mosque dome and the low sun behind them.
@char_lova_persian_v1 slowly spreads his arms wide into the wind and tilts his head back, eyes closed behind the red lenses.
@char_persian_princess_v1 leans forward toward his shoulder, smiling; the arcades and the long pool slide away far below.

shots.purpose: The flying carpet crosses the city at about 30 m at sunset, filmed from a drone flying alongside: @char_lova_persian_v1 kneels at the front nearest the camera and spreads his arms into the wind, @char_persian_princess_v1 seated behind him, the turquoise mosque dome, the minarets and the low sun behind them, the great square sliding by below

loc.time: sunset, sun low in the west
loc.desc: Low-poly Persian city seen from about 30 m at sunset: the great square with its long pool and arcades, the covered bazaar roofs, flat clay rooftops with wind towers, the turquoise mosque dome and two minarets to the west

beats.text: At blue hour @prop_flying_carpet_lp_v1 glides low over the long reflecting pool toward the camera, its reflection racing beneath it, the twelve brass lanterns lit on both sides, @char_lova_persian_v1 kneeling at the front.
It slows and settles beside the octagonal turquoise fountain, the water rippling under it.

@char_lova_persian_v1 stands up and offers his hand; @char_persian_princess_v1 rises beside him; both turn to face the turquoise-and-gold iwan and the gold dome at the end of the garden as the first stars appear.

shots.purpose: Final shot of the sequence, palace garden at blue hour: @prop_flying_carpet_lp_v1 glides low over the long reflecting pool between the lit lanterns and settles beside the turquoise fountain; @char_lova_persian_v1 stands, helps @char_persian_princess_v1 up, and the camera pans with them to the turquoise-and-gold iwan and the gold dome at the end of the garden
shots.locks: no vehicles; no modern objects, wires or signs; no other people

loc.desc: Low-poly empty Persian palace garden at blue hour: long reflecting pool with one octagonal turquoise-tiled fountain, two rows of cypress trees, red rose beds, terracotta walkway, twelve lit brass lanterns along the pool, turquoise-and-gold iwan arch and gold dome at the far end, first stars
